I have farmed in Mbeya for many years, and I know that even though the rains here are better than in other places, the soil on this small plot needs help to give a good harvest. I will buy some urea or CAN using the government voucher and I will also spread manure from my cattle, because for a piece this size I can manage that. I will plant the improved seed the extension worker gave me last season — it does well here and my family needs the food. We do not use chemicals on maize; they cost too much and the rain is enough, so we will work this plot with our hoes and do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves.
